# GTS Car Detailing

GTS Car Detailing is a doorstep car detailing and cleaning business serving Delhi and Delhi NCR.

Professional products include selected 3M car-care products and Diversey professional cleaning liquids, chosen according to the booked service, surface and material condition.

## Official website

- Home: https://gtscardetailing.shop/
- Booking: https://gtscardetailing.shop/book
- Phone and WhatsApp: +91 85958 36996
- Email: gtscardetailing24×7@gmail.com

## Core services

- Interior and exterior car cleaning
- Interior deep dry cleaning
- Exterior deep cleaning
- Rubbing and polishing
- Paint correction
- Teflon coating
- Ceramic coating
- Graphene coating
- Sofa and upholstery deep cleaning

## Service information

GTS Car Detailing provides professional service at the customer's home, office or another agreed location. Vehicle-wise prices are available for selected packages. Final pricing can vary by vehicle type, condition and agreed scope.
